why: Current OLMSmoother2 C++/Mac port is green or near-green for Color Key and Gamma Colors paths, but no-key case_0001 remains at mean 0.1832.

Two ASM-backed diagnostics were negative: suppressing/scaling only FUN_18000c280 idx=0x00 four-corner dispatch worsened the diff, and simple class/sample source-plane timing splits also worsened the diff.
A small no-key parameter grid is needed to separate class-plane firing, sample/color-space timing, and Smoothness/Smooth Range scaling without overfitting one existing reference.

inputs.description: Use the same source artwork as refs/win_references/20260605_extra/OLMSmoother2 case_0001 if possible.
Fully opaque high-contrast grid/line art with subpixel-like diagonals and colored regions.

cases.reason: Baseline pass-through check for Smooth Range 1.
Baseline pass-through check matching current case_0001 range.
Low smoothness with current case_0001 range.
Medium smoothness with current case_0001 range.
Re-render current no-key case_0001 settings under explicit render set metadata.
Baseline pass-through check for larger range.

manifest_requirements: Record all OLM Smoother v2 property names, match_names, property_index, values, enabled/active state, and selected effect path.
Record project_gpu_accel_type.current_name and raw value per render set.
Keep ADBE Force CPU GPU / GPU Rendering as reference-only metadata, not as the execution-path label.
Save both before_effects_frame and effect output PNG for every case.
If possible, preserve the same comp size and source layer artwork used by refs/win_references/20260605_extra/OLMSmoother2 case_0001.
mac_follow_up: Run the OLMSmoother2 CLI against the grid and plot mean/max by Smoothness and Smooth Range.
Use the grid to decide whether remaining case_0001 residual is Smoothness scaling, class-plane dispatch frequency, or color-space/writeback related.
